title: Dividing Island
statementMd:
A revolution took place on the Buka Island. New government replaced the old one. The new government includes $*n*$ parties and each of them is entitled to some part of the island according to their contribution to the revolution. However, they can't divide the island.

The island can be conventionally represented as two rectangles $*a* × *b*$ and $*c* × *d*$ unit squares in size correspondingly. The rectangles are located close to each other. At that, one of the sides with the length of $*a*$ and one of the sides with the length of $*c*$ lie on one line. You can see this in more details on the picture.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c919851573257c51c49fd0bc2857509b3d8bc159.png)

The $*i*$-th party is entitled to a part of the island equal to $*x*_{*i*}$ unit squares. Every such part should fully cover several squares of the island (it is not allowed to cover the squares partially) and be a connected figure. A "connected figure" presupposes that from any square of this party one can move to any other square of the same party moving through edge-adjacent squares also belonging to that party.

Your task is to divide the island between parties.

## Input

The first line contains 5 space-separated integers — $*a*$, $*b*$, $*c*$, $*d*$ and $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *a*, *b*, *c*, *d* ≤ 50$, $*b* ≠ *d*$, $1 ≤ *n* ≤ 26$). The second line contains $*n*$ space-separated numbers. The $*i*$-th of them is equal to number $*x*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *a* × *b* + *c* × *d*$). It is guaranteed that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/35d7a672005b7ad5e3d4935e2cb8334465a0bee4.png).

## Output

If dividing the island between parties in the required manner is impossible, print "`NO`" (without the quotes). Otherwise, print "`YES`" (also without the quotes) and, starting from the next line, print $*max*(*b*, *d*)$ lines each containing $*a* + *c*$ characters. To mark what square should belong to what party, use lowercase Latin letters. For the party that is first in order in the input data, use "`a`", for the second one use "`b`" and so on. Use "`.`" for the squares that belong to the sea. The first symbol of the second line of the output data should correspond to the square that belongs to the rectangle $*a* × *b*$. The last symbol of the second line should correspond to the square that belongs to the rectangle $*c* × *d*$.

If there are several solutions output any.
statementZhMd:
布卡岛发生了一场革命。新政府取代了旧政府。新政府由 $*n*$ 个政党组成，根据各党派对革命的贡献，每个政党都有权获得岛屿的一部分。然而，他们无法划分这座岛屿。

这座岛屿可以抽象地表示为两个大小分别为 $*a* × *b*$ 和 $*c* × *d*$ 的单位正方形矩形。这两个矩形彼此相邻。其中，长度为 $*a*$ 的一条边和长度为 $*c*$ 的一条边位于同一直线上。具体情况请参见下图。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c919851573257c51c49fd0bc2857509b3d8bc159.png)

第 $*i*$ 个政党有权获得面积为 $*x*_{*i*}$ 个单位正方形的岛屿部分。每个这样的部分必须完整覆盖岛屿中的若干个正方形（不允许只覆盖正方形的一部分），并且必须是一个连通图形。所谓“连通图形”，是指对于该政党的任意一个正方形，都可以通过只经过同样属于该政党的、且与边相邻的正方形，移动到该政党的任意另一个正方形。

你的任务是将岛屿在各政党之间进行划分。

## 输入格式

第一行包含 5 个以空格分隔的整数——$*a*$、$*b*$、$*c*$、$*d*$ 和 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *a*, *b*, *c*, *d* ≤ 50$，$*b* ≠ *d*$，$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 26$）。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的数。第 $*i*$ 个数等于 $*x*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ *a* × *b* + *c* × *d*$）。保证 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/35d7a672005b7ad5e3d4935e2cb8334465a0bee4.png)。

## 输出格式

如果无法按照要求在各政党之间划分岛屿，输出 `NO`（不含引号）。否则，输出 `YES`（同样不含引号），并从下一行开始输出 $*max*(*b*, *d*)$ 行，每行包含 $*a* + *c*$ 个字符。

使用小写拉丁字母标记每个正方形应属于哪个政党。对于输入数据中第一个政党，使用 `a`；对于第二个政党，使用 `b`；以此类推。对于属于海洋的正方形，使用 `.`。输出数据第二行的第一个字符应对应于属于矩形 $*a* × *b*$ 的正方形。第二行的最后一个字符应对应于属于矩形 $*c* × *d*$ 的正方形。

如果存在多个解，输出任意一个即可。
